item.title: Your 32G One-Card AutoDL Box + Existing C++ llama.cpp Can Deploy DSpark: One Command, a 1.5G Sidecar
item.description: A 32G AutoDL host that only has C++ llama.cpp: skip vLLM, skip Python. llama.cpp now carries DSpark speculative decoding natively (PR #25173) - attach a 1.5G Q8 sidecar and one flag turns it on. DSpark bets deeper than the built-in MTP, so it is fastest on short code and short QA. FP16 full-precision 54G will not fit one card, run Q4.
